Platform

From document to a record someone can stand behind.

Most of the work is predictable: reading a file, checking it against a rule, and preparing the evidence. enterlabs takes on that work. People stay with the exceptions, and every finding keeps its source beside it.

The screens below follow a supplier invoice checked against a purchase order and a delivery note. The same sequence applies wherever a team has to read, check and hand on a document.

01

Document intelligence

Extract fields and line items from any document. Review each value beside the original document. Corrections go into the audit record, and values stay linked to their source.

02

Checks and exceptions

Compare extracted values with the references you already trust. Material differences rise so an analyst can look closer.

Findings require human assessment. They do not establish fraud. A variance prompts review; it does not by itself establish an overpayment.

03

Review and a clear record

Route work to the people who should see it. Corrections and review actions stay in the audit trail. Qualified reviewers remain responsible for the decision.

Integration and deployment

Works with the systems you already have.

We map how documents and data enter the platform, and how reviewed results return. Identifiers, fields and ownership are agreed for the records you already keep. API payloads, status changes and error handling are scoped around the systems you use.

Managed cloud

Processing, storage, retention and access are scoped with your security team.

Hybrid private cloud

Document processing and personal data redaction can run in your environment before redacted data reaches the managed cloud.

Turn documents into confident decisions.
